require 'webrick'
require 'ipaddr'
require 'fluent/env'
require 'fluent/log'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/socket_option'

module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        fluent_level = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
        if @log.respond_to?(:level)
          fluent_level = @log.level
        end

        emit_debug = false
        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          emit_debug = true
        end
        level_name = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TEXT[fluent_level]

        linger_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER
        timeval_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_TIMEVAL
        platform = 'unix'
        if Fluent.windows?
          linger_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER_WINDOWS
          platform = 'windows'
        end

        protocol = :tcp
        reverse_lookup_disabled = true
        socket_manager_path = ENV['SERVERENGINE_SOCKETMANAGER_PATH']
        bind_family = :hostname
        bind_prefix = nil
        if @bind
          begin
            ipaddr = IPAddr.new(@bind)
            bind_prefix = ipaddr.prefix
            if ipaddr.ipv6?
              bind_family = :ipv6
              reverse_lookup_disabled = true
            elsif ipaddr.ipv4?
              bind_family = :ipv4
              reverse_lookup_disabled = true
            end
          rescue IPAddr::Error
            bind_family = :hostname
            reverse_lookup_disabled = true
          end
        end

        parsed_port = nil
        if @port
          candidate = @port.to_i
          if candidate > 0
            if candidate <= 65535
              parsed_port = candidate
            end
          end
        end

        oj_options = Fluent::DEFAULT_OJ_OPTIONS
        json_mode = oj_options[:mode]
        json_use_to_json = oj_options[:use_to_json]
        json_bigdecimal = oj_options[:bigdecimal_load]

        host_part = @bind.to_s
        if bind_family == :ipv6
          if host_part.length > 0
            unless host_part.start_with?('[')
              host_part = "[#{host_part}]"
            end
          end
        end
        scheme = 'http'
        listen_uri = "#{scheme}://#{host_part}:#{@port}/"

        debug_details = {
          family: bind_family,
          prefix: bind_prefix,
          level: level_name,
          json_mode: json_mode,
          json_use_to_json: json_use_to_json,
          json_bigdecimal: json_bigdecimal,
          linger_format: linger_format,
          timeval_format: timeval_format,
          parsed_port: parsed_port,
          platform: platform,
          protocol: protocol,
          socket_manager_path: socket_manager_path,
        }
        if emit_debug
          @log.debug("preparing RPC http server on #{listen_uri} #{debug_details}")
        end

        logger_io = STDERR
        logger_level = WEBrick::Log::FATAL
        webrick_logger = WEBrick::Log.new(logger_io, logger_level)
        access_log = []
        bind_address = @bind
        port_value = @port
        webrick_config = {}
        webrick_config[:BindAddress] = bind_address
        webrick_config[:Port] = port_value
        webrick_config[:Logger] = webrick_logger
        webrick_config[:AccessLog] = access_log

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(webrick_config)

        @server.listeners.each do |sock|
          if sock.respond_to?(:do_not_reverse_lookup=)
            sock.do_not_reverse_lookup = reverse_lookup_disabled
          end
        end
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC servlet"
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
          begin
            code, header, response = block.call(req, res)
          rescue => e
            @log.warn "failed to handle RPC request", path: path, error: e.to_s
            @log.warn_backtrace e.backtrace

            code = 500
            body = {
              'message '=> 'Internal Server Error',
              'error' => "#{e}",
              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          code = 200 if code.nil?
          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = if response.nil?
                   '{"ok":true}'
                 else
                   response.body['ok'] = code == 200
                   response.body.to_json
                 end

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC handler"
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

require 'webrick'
require 'ipaddr'
require 'fluent/env'
require 'fluent/log'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/socket_option'

module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        fluent_level = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
        if @log.respond_to?(:level)
          fluent_level = @log.level
        end

        emit_debug = false
        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          emit_debug = true
        end
        level_name = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TEXT[fluent_level]

        linger_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER
        timeval_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_TIMEVAL
        platform = 'unix'
        if Fluent.windows?
          linger_format = Fluent::PluginHelper::SocketOption::FORMAT_STRUCT_LINGER_WINDOWS
          platform = 'windows'
        end

        protocol = :tcp
        reverse_lookup_disabled = true
        socket_manager_path = ENV['SERVERENGINE_SOCKETMANAGER_PATH']
        bind_family = :hostname
        bind_prefix = nil
        if @bind
          begin
            ipaddr = IPAddr.new(@bind)
            bind_prefix = ipaddr.prefix
            if ipaddr.ipv6?
              bind_family = :ipv6
              reverse_lookup_disabled = true
            elsif ipaddr.ipv4?
              bind_family = :ipv4
              reverse_lookup_disabled = true
            end
          rescue IPAddr::Error
            bind_family = :hostname
            reverse_lookup_disabled = true
          end
        end

        parsed_port = nil
        if @port
          candidate = @port.to_i
          if candidate > 0
            if candidate <= 65535
              parsed_port = candidate
            end
          end
        end

        oj_options = Fluent::DEFAULT_OJ_OPTIONS
        json_mode = oj_options[:mode]
        json_use_to_json = oj_options[:use_to_json]
        json_bigdecimal = oj_options[:bigdecimal_load]

        host_part = @bind.to_s
        if bind_family == :ipv6
          if host_part.length > 0
            unless host_part.start_with?('[')
              host_part = "[#{host_part}]"
            end
          end
        end
        scheme = 'http'
        listen_uri = "#{scheme}://#{host_part}:#{@port}/"

        debug_details = {
          family: bind_family,
          prefix: bind_prefix,
          level: level_name,
          json_mode: json_mode,
          json_use_to_json: json_use_to_json,
          json_bigdecimal: json_bigdecimal,
          linger_format: linger_format,
          timeval_format: timeval_format,
          parsed_port: parsed_port,
          platform: platform,
          protocol: protocol,
          socket_manager_path: socket_manager_path,
        }
        if emit_debug
          @log.debug("preparing RPC http server on #{listen_uri} #{debug_details}")
        end

        logger_io = STDERR
        logger_level = WEBrick::Log::FATAL
        webrick_logger = WEBrick::Log.new(logger_io, logger_level)
        access_log = []
        bind_address = @bind
        port_value = @port
        webrick_config = {}
        webrick_config[:BindAddress] = bind_address
        webrick_config[:Port] = port_value
        webrick_config[:Logger] = webrick_logger
        webrick_config[:AccessLog] = access_log

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(webrick_config)

        @server.listeners.each do |sock|
          if sock.respond_to?(:do_not_reverse_lookup=)
            sock.do_not_reverse_lookup = reverse_lookup_disabled
          end
        end
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC servlet"
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
          begin
            code, header, response = block.call(req, res)
          rescue => e
            @log.warn "failed to handle RPC request", path: path, error: e.to_s
            @log.warn_backtrace e.backtrace

            code = 500
            body = {
              'message '=> 'Internal Server Error',
              'error' => "#{e}",
              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          code = 200 if code.nil?
          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = if response.nil?
                   '{"ok":true}'
                 else
                   response.body['ok'] = code == 200
                   response.body.to_json
                 end

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC handler"
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end

      private

      def parse_endpoint(endpoint)
        endpoint = endpoint.to_s
        bind = nil
        port = nil

        if endpoint.start_with?('[')
          match = /\A\[([^\]]+)\]:(\d+)\z/.match(endpoint)
          bind, port = match.captures if match
        else
          host, separator, port_string = endpoint.rpartition(':')
          unless separator.empty? || host.empty?
            bind = host
            port = port_string
          end
        end

        port = port.to_i if port
        unless bind && port && port > 0 && port <= 65535 && valid_bind?(bind)
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        [bind, port]
      end

      def valid_bind?(bind)
        begin
          IPAddr.new(bind)
          return true
        rescue IPAddr::Error
        end

        begin
          Addrinfo.getaddrinfo(bind, nil, nil, :STREAM)
          true
        rescue SocketError
          false
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
